<14 78 00><10>There is one way we can end our curse.<14 C1 00><10>All the scattered pieces of the Aztec gold must ⏎ be gathered and restored to the stone chest.<14 64 01><10>And the blood of every soul who touched ⏎ a piece o´ the treasure must be repaid.

EN: Miss Turner! For ten years we´ve searched ⏎ every league of these waters,<14 50 01><10>every town and village--preying ⏎ on sailors and settlers alike!<14 4A 01><10>Eight hundred and eighty-one pieces we found, ⏎ but despaired of ever finding the last.<14 86 01><10>All those years, you been safe in your bed,<14 D8 00><10>readin´ your pirate stories, ⏎ dreamin´ of adventures on the high seas--<14 32 01><10>we´ve endured torments ⏎ worse than death itself!

EN: <13 F2 00 9F 00><08 01 00 05>Why are you so fixated ⏎ on that compass?

<13 B4 00 FC 00><08 01 00 02>Treasure´s ⏎ already his.<10>So´s the curse upon it.<10>I´ve no desire for such ⏎ treacherous spoils.<10>But I will have back ⏎ what´s mine--<10>the Black Pearl.

EN: <13 3D 01 FA 00><08 01 01 01>You lads ⏎ wait here.<10>Young Turner and I ⏎ will rescue the lady.

but the Heartless stay!
